title: Live Companion
description: Real-time AI companion: it reviews each file you save, flags issues while you code and offers to take over when you are stuck.

state.watchingOther: The companion is watching {{project}}, not the open project.

suggestions.title: Suggestions
suggestions.empty: Start the companion, then save a file of the project: it will analyze the change.
suggestions.emptyActive: Listening. Each saved file is analyzed with the selected AI provider; nothing to report so far.

takeover.title: AI takeover
takeover.description: Paused for {{duration}} after {{count}} edits of this file. A Kanban task can pick the work up where you left it.
takeover.emptyHint: When you stop after several edits of a file, the companion offers here to turn it into a Kanban task.

task.takeoverBody: The developer stopped after {{count}} edits of this file. Read the work in progress (git diff) and finish what was started, without starting over.
task.origin: Proposed by the Live Companion: {{type}}, {{priority}} priority, {{confidence}}% confidence.
task.created: Task created in the Kanban backlog.
task.failed: The task could not be created.

errors.noProject: Select a project before starting the companion.
errors.providerHint: Check the selected AI provider and its connection, then save the file again.
